admission.justification: Valid IDs alone do not produce truthful waves, correct waves alone do not synchronize page/head/Markdown views, and drawing alone does not preserve gone/cyclic/absent-data meaning; only these members together make one dependency order survive writing and every named reader.

guarantee: Explicit same-master prerequisite data determines ordinary-master Order topology, waves and cycles, while current task state and any recorded intent-review state qualify readiness; an open intent review is named in the existing State column and is excluded from the ready list. Dependency identity remains consistent in dashboard, Markdown and both task-head directions. Dashboard task words, tones and terminal filtering come from each qualified task entry: only works entries appear under now, and every other unfinished unit appears once in its dependency wave; graph readiness is not a second task state. Invalid new references are refused; retained gone references and legacy cycles remain explicit, and no declared dependency data produces no Order. A dependency with no file-bearing document supplies id/title but no fabricated task-state word or jump. Order informs rather than gates starts and does not replace the sprint authored graph.
title: One derived master order across authoring and readers
